title: MotionCraftShot
description: Per-shot quality brief + code fields for Composer. Model fills style/camera/etc. then emits runnable html/css/js.

style.description: e.g. 电影级写实，自然光，35mm，浅景深，轻微手持

character.description: Appearance + performance; empty if no character

environment.description: Rain, fog, steam, reflections, wind debris...

camera.description: Focal feel, aperture feel, move, focus target

lighting.description: Color temp, rim, soft shadows, contact shadows

post.description: bloom, DOF feel, grain, vignette, grade

audio.description: Optional narrative audio notes (not baked into canvas)

js.description: IIFE returning { setup, draw }. Host drives t; no self rAF. No Math.random().
